levels.name: local deterministic repair
levels.trigger: normalization, derived ID/order/reference/hash or canonical wrapper defect with unique safe rewrite
levels.local_validation: rerun stage closed-schema and authority checks

levels.name: field/sub-artifact patch
levels.trigger: one typed finding maps to one model-owned path in one artifact
levels.local_validation: stage validator plus exact issue removal
levels.merge_validation: issue set strictly shrinks and unrelated hashes unchanged
levels.escalation: finding closure spans another artifact or no progress

levels.name: dependency closure patch
levels.trigger: actor/time/causal/scene finding spans a bounded connected closure
levels.merge_validation: boundary predecessors/successors plus global affected invariants
levels.escalation: closure exceeds configured unit cap or remains failing

levels.name: event/scene subtree regeneration
levels.trigger: defect cannot be expressed as field patch but has a bounded event subtree
levels.local_validation: all regenerated artifacts and boundary edges
levels.escalation: subtree unbounded, authority conflict or no progress

levels.name: stage regeneration
levels.trigger: stage-local schema/strategy failure affects most stage artifacts while authority remains exact
levels.allowed_scope: one stage only; prior stages remain frozen
levels.escalation: cross-stage authority inconsistency or repeated stage signature

levels.name: Planning restart
levels.trigger: authority/input invalidated, snapshot CAS changed, or global structure has no bounded recovery closure
levels.allowed_scope: new run with new authority snapshot; never ordinary fallback
levels.freeze: old run retained as immutable evidence, never mutated

state_change_proof: Every model retry must change at least one target payload hash or dependency hash, remove its exact prior issue signature, and preserve all non-target frozen hashes. Otherwise it is no-progress and cannot escalate by repetition.
bounded_call_formula: max_total_planning_model_calls = baseline_model_artifact_count + min(eligible_repair_artifact_count, configured_repair_ceiling) + configured_single_stage_regeneration_allowance. Values are profile materialization inputs; this design does not invent production numbers.
same_failure_policy: A repeated same finding signature with identical authority, closure and payload hashes stops immediately; it does not receive another same-scope retry.
